changes.title: Maine Democrats meet to select Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner
changes.summary: Maine Democrats are gathering Saturday to select a Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner on the ballot, with former state Senate President Troy Jackson poised to secure the nomination.

changes.title: Democrats poised to nominate Troy Jackson in must-win Maine Senate race
changes.summary: BANGOR, Maine — Former state Senate President Troy Jackson is on the cusp of becoming Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maine, starting a 101-day sprint to Election Day in a nationally watched, must-win race for his party.
